data.name: Unclassed
text: Everyone can learn a profession, but becoming classed means paying to have brume possibility bound into you. Unclassed is the tier at the bottom, before F. The heroes start Unclassed.

data.name: Binding
text: Making Possibility permanent in a person, which is what produces grade. Licensed in Compact waters; licensed binding carries a debt to the Compact. In the game, binding is the paid step that gives a hero their class.

data.name: Monsterkin
text: The race family once listed as Monster. Monsterkin hate being lumped in with the mindless beasts and monsters of the world; they are no less enlightened than anyone, just with different challenges. "Monster" is what the Compact writes on the manifest.

data.name: the inventor's pocket watch
text: Crystal-faced and engraved: a token of identity and remembrance of Enkrid's goals. The inventor leaves it with him before the legends depart.

data.name: danger fee
text: What a crew presses a broker for when a job turns out worse than described. Brokers pay it because a crew that talks is bad for business.
